_schema_notes.project_reference: text. Pre-existing. I had wrongly invented project_ref.
_schema_notes.payment_date: date. Pre-existing. Needs YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss, not the readable form.
_schema_notes.quote_status: radio. Pre-existing. The value must match a defined option or it is ignored. Options not yet confirmed.
_schema_notes.enquiry_date: date. Pre-existing and previously unused; Phase 1 now fills it.
_schema_notes.amount_paid: number. Created 2026-09-24. Receives the bare value, e.g. 849, while the email shows £849.00.
_schema_notes.phase_1_no_longer_writes_quote_status: With __force_update set, a repeat enquiry from a customer who had already paid would have reset their status from Paid back to Enquiry received. Quote status belongs to the quoting and payment stages only.
